scope: General iron function, dietary sources, population context and public safety guidance
reference_summary: The NHS page is an independent public-health reference for iron. It does not validate the composition, form, efficacy, suitability, dose or safety of any Strunz product or individual use case; iron-specific population and safety review remains required.
dose_handling: Any numeric guidance on the source remains source context only and is not imported as a patient, product or practice dose.
